McBride Congresswoman Sarah McBride proudly represents the greatest state in the nation, and our country’s First State, Delaware, as its sole member of Congress. Sarah grew up in Wilmington and has been serving our state for decades as a public servant and advocate. From 2020-2025, Congresswoman McBride served as State Senator for the First State Senate District. She worked for former Governor Jack Markell and the late Attorney General Beau Biden, and served as the national spokesperson for the Human Rights Campaign, the nation’s largest LGBTQ equal rights organization. As a state senator, McBride passed legislation expanding access to health care, requiring mental health and media literacy education in public schools, promoting green technologies, and protecting workers and families. In her first term as state senator, McBride passed the landmark Healthy Delaware Families Act, providing paid family and medical leave to workers throughout the First State and marking the largest expansion of Delaware's social safety net in decades. In her final term, she passed the largest ongoing investment into Delaware’s Medicaid program since the Affordable Care Act. Passing the legislation with unanimous and bipartisan support, the Protect Medicaid Act of 2024 unlocks over $175 million annually in new discretionary Medicaid funding to protect, enhance, and expand health coverage for the roughly 200,000 Delawareans who receive care through the joint state- and federal-funded health insurance program.   read more Latest News PHOTO RELEASE: Rep. McBride Statement on USS Abraham Lincoln August 14, 2026 Press Release WILMINGTON, Del. — Today, U.S. Representative Sarah McBride (D-Del.), member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, released the following statement in response to reports of conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln: “The reporting about what’s happening aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln is disturbing and underscores just how detrimental the Trump administration’s decision to go to war in Iran has been for our servicemembers and their families. “These sailors and Marines haven’t seen land in more than 200 days. They’re facing serious mental health challenges and concerning living conditions, while their families struggle to get answers to basic questions about the safety and well-being of their loved ones. And yet, Secretary Hegseth denies that anything is wrong aboard the ship. “This situation cannot continue. These conditions must be remedied immediately and there must be accountability. “You cannot play politics with the lives of our servicemembers. Yet that’s exactly what this administration has done — all while demanding a ballooned defense budget that fails to deliver for the servicemembers it is supposed to support. “The American military represents the very best of America. The men and women who serve our country deserve leadership that respects their service, safeguards their well-being, and understands the profound responsibility that comes with being commander-in-chief.” Media Press Releases In the News Delaware Paid Leave McBride Memo

McBride, Senators Coons, Blunt Rochester Celebrate Nearly $1 Million Investment in Affordable Housing for Kent and Sussex Counties July 22, 2026 Press Release USDA Rural Development funding will support construction for 24 energy-efficient homes for Delaware families in rural communities WASHINGTON, DC — Today, U.S. Representative Sarah McBride and U.S. Senators Chris Coons and Lisa Blunt Rochester (all D-Del.) celebrated a $940,000 U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Rural Development grant for Milford Housing Development Corporation. The funding, awarded through the USDA Rural Development’s 523 Mutual Self-Help Housing Technical Assistance Grant program, will support the construction of two dozen new, energy-efficient homes for low-income families in rural communities throughout Sussex and Kent Counties.
